data.one_liner: A widget that adds a social‑media style button to record audio to a file.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a ready‑made button that starts and stops microphone recording, saving the result to a given path. It wraps the `record` package and exposes common audio encoders while handling required permissions.
use_when: You need a quick, cross‑platform audio‑record button with minimal code
You want a UI that mimics social‑media voice messages
You prefer a widget that manages permissions for you
avoid_when: You require advanced audio processing or streaming
You need background or continuous recording beyond a button press
You want fine‑grained control over the recording pipeline
strengths: Very easy to drop into a UI
Handles Android/iOS permission setup in docs
Supports multiple audio encoders including OPUS
Lightweight wrapper around the popular `record` package
weaknesses: Limited customization of the button UI
No support for background or continuous recording
Relies on the `record` package; bugs there affect this package
data.setup_notes: Add RECORD_AUDIO and WRITE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE permissions to AndroidManifest, set android:requestLegacyExternalStorage="true" if needed; add NSMicrophoneUsageDescription to iOS Info.plist and configure the podfile as shown; ensure permission_handler is initialized.

alternatives.name: record
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides lower‑level recording APIs without UI, allowing full custom UI and more control
